events.verdict: Durant (GSW) dislodges Adams (OKC) from his post position during the pass.
Looney (GSW) establishes a legal picking position in Schröder's (OKC) path before the contact.
Schröder (OKC) trails Curry (GSW) and makes contact with his body during his shooting motion.
Durant (GSW) obtains a legal defensive position before George (OKC) initiates contact. The players briefly engage and separate.
Adams (OKC) is already in Durant's (GSW) path when he and Looney (GSW) move forward slightly. Adams does not deliver or extend into Durant's path.
Curry (GSW) is in a legal guarding position as he moves along Ferguson's (OKC) path during the drive to the basket and any contact is incidental.
Green (GSW) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Adams (OKC) after the release of his shot attempt in the lane.
Schröder (OKC) briefly places two hands on Curry (GSW) off ball without affecting his SQBR.
LHH shows that Durant (GSW) loses control of the ball on his own, after which Ferguson (OKC) makes contact with the ball and makes incidental contact with Durant as they try to retrieve it.
LHH shows that Ferguson (OKC) makes contact with the ball and Durant (GSW) regains control and continues his dribble.
Looney (GSW) is in Durant's (GSW) path before the contact on the hand-off. While he is turned, he has already established himself in Durant's path and absorbs the contact when it occurs.

RLS shows that Grant (OKC) obtains a vertical position and absorbs contact from Looney (GSW) on the play at the basket. Since the play originates inside the lower defensive box (the area between the 3' posted-up marks, the bottom tip of the circle and the endline), Grant can be on the floor in the restricted area when the contact occurs.
Durant (GSW) engages with George (OKC) but does not affect his FOM.
Thompson (GSW) maintains a legal guarding position on George's (OKC) jump shot attempt.
Looney (GSW) and Adams (OKC) briefly engage and then disengage during the rebound.
George (OKC) briefly rests his hand on Durant's (GSW) back but does not dislodge him.
[Observable in enhanced video] Adams (OKC) has his foot on the lane line and is not actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.
RLB shows that Adams (OKC) plants and jumps vertically to contest Durant's driving shot attempt. Durant extends his leg and creates the contact with Adams. His momentum carries his body forward.

Schröder (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position with a legal hand to Durant's (GSW) side during his drive to the basket and shot attempt. Multiple angles are reviewed and he appears to pull his arm back when Durant is in the shooting motion.
Green (GSW) cleanly strips the ball from Schröder (OKC).
Abrines (OKC) initiates the body contact with Durant (GSW) and affects his SQBR.
Green (GSW) is not in a legal guarding position, initiating the leg contact with George (OKC) that causes him to trip and lose control of the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] LHH shows that Curry (GSW) lifts his pivot foot slightly as he spins.
